mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_dead_event (id, consumer_group, event_id, tenant_id, original_tenant_id, topic, tag, payload, delivery_attempt, last_error) VALUES (#{id}, #{consumerGroup}, #{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{originalTenantId}, #{topic}, #{tag}, #{payload}, #{deliveryAttempt}, #{lastError}) ON CONFLICT (consumer_group, event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: id, consumer_group, event_id, tenant_id, topic, tag, delivery_attempt, last_error, status, created_at, resolved_at, resolution_reason
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM forge_dead_event
status = #{status}
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, consumer_group, event_id, original_tenant_id, topic, tag, payload FROM forge_dead_event WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_dead_event SET status = #{status}, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, resolution_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE forge_dead_event SET last_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM forge_dead_event WHERE status IN ('REPLAYED', 'ABANDONED') AND resolved_at < #{cutoff}
